history: Configuration for calibration of UKESM1 atmosphere with Cess feedback included.
Developer_comment: StudyConfig.py provides methods that work with this configuration file. Remember to change them if you change structure of this.
Name: low_cess_1

run_info.runCode_comment: Project code to run job with.
run_info.submit_engine_comment: Name of engine to submit runs to. See engine.py for allowed values.  Use null if want this guessed.
run_info.ssh_node_comment: If not null then name of machine which has access to engine. Will ssh to this machine to submit commands
run_info.modelName_comment: Name of model that is ran. MUST be provided
run_info.maxRuns_comment: Maximum number of runs to do in parallel. Jobs submitted is 2x this + 1.
run_info.max_model_simulations_comment: The maximum number of model sims to be done. Overwrites per algorithm max evaluations
run_info.test_nondetermin_comment: If value is error an error is triggered if algorithm appears to be behaving non-deterministically. If value is warning a warning is given. Default is error.
run_info.runQueue_comment: Q to run all optclim jobs in
run_info.runExtraArgs_comment: List of extra args for submission. For archer2 need to specify qos for pp job and resubmission
run_info.prebuild_comment: If True guess from ref model. If string use as path to prebuild. Path should be on puma2
run_info.use_scratch_comment: use scratch space on Archer2. Means models get cleaned up after 28 days.
run_info.module_name_comment: Name of module that contains modelName class. If not specified then modelName will be used

run_info_comment: Information  for run_info. Must include submit_engine and modelName. Can include other keys for use in submission. Useful ones are runTime, runCode & maxRuns
optimiseFunction_comment: Name of optimisation function to run. null gives default
runUpgrade_vn4: For vn4 add list of things to do here!

initParams_old_not_used._comment: Oold initial values for parameters to be optimised. Set to null to use default values. Turn on for testing

initial.initScale_comment: If true then startParams range from 0 to 1 where 0 means min value; 1 max value.

fixedParams._comment: List of parameters and values that are fixed and not modified in optimisation. Set to null to use default values
fixedParams.multiple_function_comment: Name of function to run when multiple simulations are needed. This case does a Std AMIP & a +4K AMIP. Then computed Cess feedback.

control.reference_comment: Reference model directory. AMIP run for 2011

fixedParams.fixedScale_comment: If true then scalable fixedParams range from 0 to 1 where 0 means min value; 1 max value.

study.comment: Parameters that specify the study. Used by framework and not by optimisation routines

covariance.comment: Covariance matrices and operations on them. If CovObsErr and CovIntVar are *both* specified then CovTotal will be computed from them. TODO MOVE coviariance info somewhere else..
covariance.CovTotal_Comment: Name of file containing Covariance Matrix for total Error. FIXME when have final internal var
covariance.CovTotalDiagonalise_comment: If true diagonalise the total covariance matrix
covariance.CovIntVar_Comment: Name of file containing Covariance Matrix of Internal Variability. Needs to be set.
covariance.CovIntVarDiagonalise_comment: If true diagonalise the internal variability covariance matrix
covariance.CovObsErr_Comment: Name of file containing Covariance Matrix for Observational Error. This is for 2011
covariance.CovObsErrDiagonalise_comment: If true diagonalise the Observational Error covariance matrix

study.ObsList_comment: List of observations used in the study.
study.constraintName_comment: Name of constraint variable -- target value defined by targets/constraintName.

optimise._comment: Parameters to control optimisation. This is used within DFOLS optimisation routines AND not by framework.
optimise.mu_comment: The inverse weighting given to the constraint -- it gets wt 1/(2mu). If Null then no constraint should be applied
optimise.dfols_comment: DFOLS settings. See dfols_settings.ijson for details

postProcess._comment: Options for post-processing. Broadly anything with null values will get default values given by the script. See script for details
postProcess.script_comment: Path to script to run. Need to wrap in a shell script to set up environment
postProcess.dir_comment: Directory relative to model dir where postprocessing is done. Default is model dir
postProcess.output_file_comment: Path relative to model dir -- should be one of .nc, .json or .csv
postProcess.mask_variable_comment: Variable name for the mask field
postProcess.mask_fraction_comment: Critical Fraction. Specify if mask  is a land/sea fraction. Values >= are land Values < sea. Set to null if mask is a t/f mask
postProcess.time_range_comment: Start & end time as ISO std string or null for no start or end.
postProcess.file_pattern_comment: File pattern to match for post-processing. Normal glob rules
